en: A black and white photograph depicting a large outdoor horse show or agricultural exhibition. Many horses are lined up in rows, each accompanied by a handler. There are several people walking around and observing, and flagpoles with flags can be seen in the background. The location appears to be a fairground or similar open area, with long buildings and a rural backdrop. The text on the postcard is in Finnish.
